sample_unit: clinical questions (each response rated by 8 blinded experts)

links.outcome: Expert-blinded ratings of AI versus physician replies to fertility counselling questions
links.effect: Physicians scored higher than AI (P < 0.001). Median scores: Doctor A 9.0, Doctor B 8.0, ChatGPT 7.0, Gemini 4.5. Responses scoring ≥8: 70.8%, 56.3%, 47.9%, 35.4%.
links.quote: The replies authored by physicians received significantly higher overall scores than those generated by AI models (P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates generative AI models (ChatGPT and Gemini) against physician responses on clinical fertility counselling questions rated by expert evaluators, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
